ability.name: Step 0 - Machine Context Check (Windows)
ability.description: Performs local context check including identity, domain status, active privilege string parsing, and active EDR/AV product enumeration.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $av=@(); try { $av_wmi=Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\SecurityCenter2 -Class AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($av_wmi){$av+=$av_wmi.displayName} } catch {}; $running_services=Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Running' }; $edr_keywords=@('defender','crowdstrike','carbon','sentinel','cylance','cortex','sysmon'); foreach($keyword in $edr_keywords){ if($running_services | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*$keyword*" -or $_.DisplayName -like "*$keyword*" }){ $av+=$keyword } }; $av_json=$av | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $privs=@(); try { $raw_privs=whoami /priv; foreach($line in $raw_privs){ if($line -match '(Se\w+Privilege)'){ $privs+=$Matches[1] } } } catch {}; $privs_json=$privs | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $cs=Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; $dom=$cs.PartOfDomain; $dn=$cs.Domain; $hn=$env:COMPUTERNAME; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "host.av_edr: $av_json"; Write-Output "host.token_privileges: $privs_json" } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step0.txt

rationale: Required to cleanly parse and output host.av_edr and privilege array tokens (host.token_privileges) per the evaluator requirements.
